name: Circle of the Shepherd
summary: Druids who speak for beasts and summon guardian spirits.

features.name: Speech of the Woods
features.short: Learn Sylvan; Speak with Animals at will.
features.summary: You learn to speak, read and write Sylvan, and beasts can understand your speech. You can cast Speak with Animals at will.

features.name: Spirit Totem
features.short: Summon a Bear, Hawk or Unicorn spirit aura.
features.summary: As a bonus action, summon a spirit for 1 minute in a 30 ft. aura: Bear (temp HP and advantage on STR), Hawk (reaction: advantage on an attack, advantage on Perception) or Unicorn (advantage to detect creatures, healing spells heal everyone nearby). Once per short or long rest.

features.name: Mighty Summoner
features.short: Summoned beasts and fey get +2 HP per Hit Die and magic attacks.
features.summary: Beasts and fey you conjure with spells gain 2 extra hit points per Hit Die, and their natural weapons count as magical.

features.name: Guardian Spirit
features.short: Summoned creatures in your totem aura heal each turn.
features.summary: When a beast or fey you summoned ends its turn in your Spirit Totem aura, it regains hit points equal to half your druid level.

features.name: Faithful Summons
features.short: Drop to 0 HP: four beasts appear to protect you.
features.summary: When you are reduced to 0 hit points or incapacitated against your will, you can gain the benefits of Conjure Animals as if cast with a 9th-level slot (four CR 2 or lower beasts protect you for 1 hour). Once per long rest.
